$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a Hamptons and Nantucket shingle-style estate builder content seed (Hallock & Sons, Amagansett), a navy brand, and the shingle register. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Shingle-style estate builder
description: A family estate builder's site as a country-house quarterly: the engraved title over the estate at dawn, one house told as a long-form feature — the story in two columns under a drop cap, the porch as a spread, a pull quote, the shingle and the newel post up close, the elevation drawing — then the lanes the family has built on and a commission inquiry — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this team's own week, not the base demo business's.

types.name: A call with a Hallock
types.description: The property, the house, and the timeline — a first conversation.

types.name: Property visit
types.description: A Hallock walks the property with you and your architect.

theme.$comment: Navy as the brand: on the shingle register the accent is the ink of the ask, the rules and the crest, so a rebrand re-inks the letterhead without re-shooting the estate. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome to the inline letterhead (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop). mode light opens on the ivory laid stock (theme merges shallowly).

landing.$comment: The pin: the shingle register and the quarterly home — the engraved title over the estate (full-bleed-media; the seed's hero kicker under the crest), one estate as a long-form story (the seed's feature as content-split feature: two columns, the spread, the pull quote, the figures, the elevation), the lanes as a spaced line (service-area), and the commission ask. The seed hides the home services grid (home.serviceGrid). The estates page opens on the restorations as before/after comparisons over how a commission runs; the about page carries the numbers. resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
